A single-block SHA-256 compression core implementing FIPS 180-4. Ports: clk, rst_n, start, init, block_in[511:0], busy, done, digest[255:0]. The core is idle until start is high on a rising clock edge, which captures block_in and begins processing; busy is high from that edge until the digest is available, and the core accepts a new start only while it is not busy. When init is high with start, compression begins from the FIPS 180-4 initial hash values H0 through H7; when init is low, it continues from the digest the core currently holds, so successive blocks of a longer message are chained. The core performs the 64 SHA-256 rounds using the standard message schedule W, where W[t] is message word t for t below 16 and otherwise sigma1(W[t-2]) + W[t-7] + sigma0(W[t-15]) + W[t-16] under 32-bit modular addition, the 64 round constants K from FIPS 180-4, and the working-variable update built from Sigma0, Sigma1, Ch and Maj. After the final round the eight working variables are added to the incoming hash values under 32-bit modular addition to form the new digest. done is asserted for exactly one clock cycle when the digest is valid, busy is low in that same cycle, and digest holds its value until the next start. block_in is big-endian: bits 511 down to 480 are message word W[0], and digest bits 255 down to 224 are hash word H0. Reset clears busy, done and digest.
